encodings_note: TWO ENCODINGS, WRITTEN INDEPENDENTLY, and they are not versions of each other. 'legalese' is the mirror corpus: scoped to exactly the eight requirement groups one external wiki page presents (regcf.l4:14-26), with a rule-version axis back to commencement on 16 May 2016 (regcf.l4:114-128) and a founder/investor façade module carrying the @export surface. 'cleanroom-2026-08' addresses all 22 sections of the part as in force from 2023-03-01, written de novo from source/ without reading 'legalese', so that registers/surface-map.json and the differential it drives compare two encodings rather than one encoding with itself. Both rows were deposited from legalese/l4-ide on 2026-09-23 byte-identical to jl4/examples/legal/regcf/ at l4-ide 7df7a3ca6; that directory keeps the corpus's README.md, PROJECTIONS.md and ladder figures, which describe l4-ide's own projections of it.
